raw_instruction: DME required. MISSED APPROACH: Climb to 2900 then Circling Rwy 2 NA at night. Autopilot coupled approach NA below MALSR climbing left turn to 6000 on COE R-350 2840. Simultaneous reception of I-COE localizer and COE DME outbound then climbing left turn to 6500 on COE R-350 inbound to COE VOR/DME and hold.
